Quick scan of synapse_requests.csv and our token-issue logs shows a clustered pattern:

- 8 of 9 voucher requests originated from two IP blocks (198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/25) within 18 hours.
- Contact emails for two teams are disposable-provider-style and auto-registered within the last 24 hours.
- Several requests reused the same replayed client_id in the request metadata.

If this is coordinated pilot activity, we can lift the hold quickly; if it's abuse we should revoke the issued vouchers and block the implicated IP ranges. I've opened JIRA SUP-9812 to track investigations and evidence.
